summary: Hercules Capital filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Twelfth Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust, as trustee, covering a $400 million public offering of 6.700% Notes due October 8, 2029. Interest pays semiannually each April 8 and October 8, first payment April 8, 2027. The notes are unsecured senior obligations, unguaranteed, pari passu with existing unsubordinated debt, effectively junior to secured borrowings and structurally junior to subsidiary obligations; redeemable at par plus make-whole premium. This is a routine debt-takedown financing, not a special situation; covenants track 1940 Act Sections 18(a)(1)(A) and 18(a)(1)(B) as modified by Section 61(a). Watch leverage, coupon cost versus portfolio yield, and BDC financing conditions rather than deal terms.
